text.common.ts: shared helpers and types for section renderers
text.common.ts gotcha: a cite renders as a graph link only when both the cite and the map mark it mapped
text.controller.ts: opens, closes and refreshes the sections overlay, keeping each db section's filters across refreshes
text.controller.ts gotcha: graph is inert while a section is open; Esc is caught on document, clearing a filled db search first

text.registry.ts gotcha: RENDERERS is exhaustive over section types, so a new type needs a renderer here
text.states.ts: renders a states section as SVG diagrams and tables
text.states.ts gotcha: transition numbers follow list order; arcs to undeclared states are dropped but keep their number
